quality.rationale: Open P2 backlog is implemented and verified with automated tests, production build, and headless Chromium runtime gate. Coverage includes exactly 10 bundled default templates, template metadata, guided start, brand kit helpers, quality warning helpers, edit-state JSON recovery helpers, CSV/HTML persistence, inspector editing, WebP export, mobile no-overflow, user-facing docs, and QCDS evidence. Cross-browser and real-device edge cases remain future work.

cost.rationale: Static browser-only GitHub Pages app with no backend, no paid service dependency, browser-local edit state, template, color, saved palette, and custom font storage, and client-side YouTube thumbnail import.

delivery.rationale: TODO and local Issues are closed, implementation and docs are aligned, README, user guide, and screenshot guide are present, QCDS evidence is recorded, tests/build/runtime gate pass, and docs packaging remains available through the existing workflow. A fresh remote Pages run after this commit remains pending until pushed.

satisfaction.rationale: Requested 10 practical bundled templates passed validation, Issue 0064 adds a screenshot-based guide, and Issues 0065-0068 add beginner guided creation, template filters/previews, creator brand reuse, quality warnings, state JSON recovery, and in-app issue/privacy display. CSV/HTML import/export persistence works, WebP export works, and QCDS evidence is updated. Remaining satisfaction risk is broader real-user font files, real-device checks, and non-Chromium browser coverage.
